blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解凍結點下降滲透量計 (freezing-point depression osmometer) 的構造原理與操作機制
blocks.en: Understand the construction principle and operating mechanism of the freezing-point depression osmometer

blocks.zh: 理解蒸氣壓滲透量計 (vapor pressure osmometer) 的露點測量原理及其使用限制
blocks.en: Understand the dew-point measurement principle of the vapor pressure osmometer and its limitations

blocks.zh: 掌握 USP 〈1058〉 框架下 Group B 儀器資格確認（IQ / OQ / PQ）的要求
blocks.en: Grasp the requirements for Group B instrument qualification (IQ / OQ / PQ) under the USP <1058> framework

blocks.zh: 計算並評估滲透量計的精確度（repeatability，RSD ≤ 2%）與準確度（±4 mOsmol/kg 或 ±1%）
blocks.en: Calculate and evaluate osmometer precision (repeatability, RSD ≤ 2%) and accuracy (±4 mOsmol/kg or ±1%)

blocks.zh: 了解溫度差異對不同類型滲透量計結果的影響，及為何同一樣品可能得到不同讀數
blocks.en: Understand how temperature differences affect the results of different types of osmometer, and why the same sample may give different readings

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 兩種測量時機的本質差異：
blocks.en: The essential difference in measurement conditions:

blocks.zh: 凍結點法：在樣品的凍結點（約 -0.5°C 附近）測量 → 代表凍結點溫度下的 osmolality
blocks.en: Freezing-point method: measures at the freezing point of the sample (around -0.5°C) → represents osmolality at the freezing-point temperature

blocks.zh: 蒸氣壓法（露點法）：在室溫（約 25°C）測量 → 代表室溫下的 osmolality
blocks.en: Vapor pressure (dew-point) method: measures at room temperature (about 25°C) → represents osmolality at room temperature

blocks.zh: 對含溫度敏感解離常數的溶質（如緩衝液、弱電解質），兩法結果可能有顯著差異，這不是誤差，是物理現象。
blocks.en: For solutes whose dissociation constants are temperature sensitive (such as buffers and weak electrolytes), the results of the two methods can differ significantly. This is not an error; it is a physical phenomenon.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 含揮發性成分的樣品（乙醇、乙腈、某些香精）禁止使用蒸氣壓法。揮發性溶質在密封腔體中快速蒸發，改變了氣相組成，導致露點讀數偏高（低估 osmolality）。這是 CDMO 製劑開發的常見誤操作陷阱。
blocks.en: Samples containing volatile components (ethanol, acetonitrile, certain flavorings) must not be measured by the vapor pressure method. Volatile solutes evaporate rapidly in the sealed chamber and change the composition of the gas phase, giving a falsely high dew-point reading (underestimating osmolality). This is a common trap for mistakes in CDMO formulation development.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 同一個人在冰天雪地（凍結點法）與夏天（蒸氣壓法）的生理狀態是不同的。人體的代謝率、血液黏度、電解質解離程度都隨溫度改變。滲透量計也一樣——「在什麼溫度測」決定「量到什麼」。所以比較兩台不同原理的滲透量計時，必須理解它們在本質上測的是不同條件下的滲透量。
blocks.en: The same person is in a different physiological state in the snow and ice (freezing-point method) than in summer (vapor pressure method): metabolic rate, blood viscosity and the degree of electrolyte dissociation all change with temperature. The same is true of osmometers: "at what temperature you measure" determines "what you measure". So when comparing two osmometers that work on different principles, you must understand that they are essentially measuring osmolality under different conditions.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個含磷酸緩衝液的注射劑，用凍結點法測得 295 mOsmol/kg，用蒸氣壓法測得 288 mOsmol/kg。請問哪個值更接近靜脈注射後的生理效應？
blocks.en: An injection containing a phosphate buffer measures 295 mOsmol/kg by the freezing-point method and 288 mOsmol/kg by the vapor pressure method. Which value is closer to the physiological effect after intravenous injection?

blocks.zh: 某製劑含 5% 乙醇（賦形劑），你的 QC 部門應選擇哪種滲透量計？請寫出理由。
blocks.en: A formulation contains 5% ethanol (as an excipient). Which type of osmometer should your QC department choose? Give your reasons.

blocks.zh: Freezing-Point Depression Osmometer 凍結點下降滲透量計
blocks.en: Freezing-Point Depression Osmometer

blocks.zh: 測量流程三階段：
blocks.en: The three stages of the measurement process:

blocks.zh: 冷卻（Supercooling）：樣品被冷卻至預期凍結點以下 1–3°C，使其進入過冷狀態（液態卻低於凍結點）
blocks.en: Cooling (Supercooling): the sample is cooled 1–3°C below its expected freezing point so that it enters a supercooled state (liquid but below its freezing point)

blocks.zh: 觸發結晶（Buzz）：施加短暫震動或電脈衝，觸發水分子開始結晶
blocks.en: Triggering crystallization (Buzz): a brief vibration or electrical pulse is applied to trigger the water molecules to begin crystallizing

blocks.zh: 相變平衡（Plateau）：結晶放出的潛熱使溫度回升，直到達到真實凍結點（溫度-時間曲線的平坦段）→ 讀取此溫度即為凍結點
blocks.en: Phase-change equilibrium (Plateau): the latent heat released by crystallization raises the temperature until it reaches the true freezing point (the flat section of the temperature-time curve) → the temperature read at this point is the freezing point

blocks.zh: 想像一瓶超市賣的純淨水，冰箱冷藏到 -2°C 卻不結冰（過冷現象）。當你輕輕搖晃它，瞬間結成冰——這就是 "buzz" 的作用。結冰過程中釋放的「凝固潛熱」讓溫度回升到真正的凍結點，儀器就是在這個平台期讀取溫度。溶液比純水多了溶質，凍結點更低，偏移量就是 osmolality 的訊號。
blocks.en: Imagine a bottle of purified water from the supermarket that is chilled to -2°C without freezing (supercooling). When you give it a gentle shake, it turns to ice instantly; that is what the "buzz" does. The "latent heat of fusion" released during freezing brings the temperature back up to the true freezing point, and the instrument reads the temperature during this plateau. A solution contains solute that pure water does not, so its freezing point is lower, and that shift is the osmolality signal.

blocks.zh: 樣品量範圍：標準型 0.02–2 mL；微量型 <100 µL（無需攪拌）。微量型特別適合珍貴候選藥物的早期開發階段，當樣品量極為有限時。
blocks.en: Sample volume range: standard type 0.02–2 mL; micro type <100 µL (no stirring required). The micro type is especially suitable for early development of precious drug candidates, when sample volume is extremely limited.

blocks.zh: 溫度-時間曲線判讀：凍結點是曲線上升段的漸近線（asymptote），不是尖峰值。若曲線沒有明確平台，表示樣品未完全凍結，讀數不可靠。
blocks.en: Interpreting the temperature-time curve: the freezing point is the asymptote of the rising section of the curve, not the peak value. If the curve has no clear plateau, the sample has not frozen completely and the reading is unreliable.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 QC 實驗室中，凍結點滲透量計是注射劑批次放行的標配儀器。對於高黏度樣品（如生物製劑配方含高濃度蛋白質或 PEG），樣品可能難以凍結，需要調整 buzz 參數或攪拌速度。此類 troubleshooting 必須在 OQ 階段提前驗證，並記入標準操作程序。
blocks.en: In a CDMO QC laboratory, the freezing-point osmometer is the standard instrument for injectable batch release. For high-viscosity samples (such as biologic formulations containing high concentrations of protein or PEG), the sample may be difficult to freeze, and the buzz parameters or stirring speed may need adjusting. Such troubleshooting must be verified in advance at the OQ stage and recorded in the standard operating procedure.

blocks.zh: 若一個樣品在凍結點測量中沒有出現明顯的溫度平台（plateau），可能的原因是什麼？如何排除？
blocks.en: If a sample shows no clear temperature plateau in a freezing-point measurement, what are the possible causes? How can they be eliminated?

blocks.zh: 為什麼微量型凍結點滲透量計（<100 µL）不需要攪拌？
blocks.en: Why does a micro-type freezing-point osmometer (<100 µL) not need stirring?

blocks.zh: 「過冷（supercooling）」現象是凍結點法的缺陷還是必要條件？請說明。
blocks.en: Is "supercooling" a defect of the freezing-point method or a necessary condition? Explain.

blocks.zh: Vapor Pressure Osmometer 蒸氣壓滲透量計
blocks.en: Vapor Pressure Osmometer

blocks.zh: Peltier effect（帕爾帖效應）：通電後在兩種不同導體的接合面產生吸熱或放熱的熱電現象。蒸氣壓法用此原理精確將熱電偶冷卻到露點以下。
blocks.en: Peltier effect: a thermoelectric phenomenon in which, when a current is applied, heat is absorbed or released at the junction of two dissimilar conductors. The vapor pressure method uses this principle to cool the thermocouple precisely to below the dew point.

blocks.zh: Dew-point temperature depression（露點下降）：溶液上方的空氣比純水上方的空氣需要更低的溫度才能達到飽和（因為溶質降低了水的蒸氣壓）。這個溫度差就是蒸氣壓法量 osmolality 的訊號。
blocks.en: Dew-point temperature depression: the air above a solution needs a lower temperature to reach saturation than the air above pure water (because the solute lowers the vapor pressure of the water). This temperature difference is the signal by which the vapor pressure method measures osmolality.

blocks.zh: 樣品量優勢：蒸氣壓法只需 5–20 µL，遠少於凍結點法（20–2000 µL）。
blocks.en: Sample volume advantage: the vapor pressure method needs only 5–20 µL, far less than the freezing-point method (20–2000 µL).

blocks.zh: 夏天早晨草地上的露珠，形成於草的溫度低於環境露點時。含溶質的水比純水更難形成露水（蒸氣壓更低），就像「更不願意蒸發的水」——需要冷卻到更低溫度才會凝結。蒸氣壓滲透量計就是精確量測這個「凝結點」的差異來反推溶液的 osmolality。
blocks.en: Think of the dew on grass on a summer morning, which forms when the temperature of the grass falls below the dew point of the surrounding air. Water containing solute forms dew less readily than pure water (its vapor pressure is lower); it is like "water that is even less willing to evaporate", and it has to be cooled to a lower temperature before it condenses. The vapor pressure osmometer measures precisely this difference in "condensation point" in order to work back to the osmolality of the solution.

blocks.zh: 溫度控制至關重要：蒸氣壓法在室溫操作，但室溫波動會直接影響測量結果。USP 要求確保樣品與儀器都完全平衡至實驗室溫度後再測量（儀器開機至少 30 分鐘）。
blocks.en: Temperature control is critical: the vapor pressure method operates at room temperature, but fluctuations in room temperature directly affect the result. USP requires that the sample and the instrument both be fully equilibrated to laboratory temperature before measurement (the instrument should be powered on for at least 30 minutes).

blocks.zh: 加樣一致性：使用校正過的移液器，樣品加入時機（timing）必須一致，與校正時保持相同操作程序——這是保證 repeatability 的關鍵。
blocks.en: Consistent sample application: use a calibrated pipette, keep the timing of sample application consistent, and follow the same procedure as used for calibration; this is the key to ensuring repeatability.

blocks.zh: 揮發性成分禁用：乙醇等揮發性溶質會在密封腔體中快速蒸發至氣相，干擾露點測量，導致系統性偏低的 osmolality 讀數。
blocks.en: No volatile components: volatile solutes such as ethanol evaporate rapidly into the gas phase in the sealed chamber and interfere with the dew-point measurement, giving systematically low osmolality readings.

blocks.zh: 為什麼蒸氣壓法要求儀器開機至少 30 分鐘才能測量？這與凍結點法的要求有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does the vapor pressure method require the instrument to be powered on for at least 30 minutes before measurement? How does this differ from the requirements of the freezing-point method?

blocks.zh: 若使用紙片式加樣的蒸氣壓法儀器，為何紙片必須是「無溶質」的？若紙片殘留雜質會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If a vapor pressure instrument that uses paper-disc sample application is used, why must the discs be "solute-free"? What would be the effect of residual impurities on the discs?

blocks.zh: 比較凍結點法與蒸氣壓法的樣品量需求，在哪些臨床前藥物開發情境下蒸氣壓法更具優勢？
blocks.en: Compare the sample volume requirements of the freezing-point and vapor pressure methods. In which preclinical drug development situations does the vapor pressure method have the advantage?

blocks.zh: Qualification of Osmolality Instruments — Overview 資格確認概述
blocks.en: Qualification of Osmolality Instruments — Overview

blocks.zh: Group B instruments（B 類儀器）：USP 〈1058〉 依儀器複雜度分類。Group A（簡單工具，如容量瓶）無需正式 OQ；Group B（有測量功能的儀器，如 osmometer、天平、pH 計）需 IQ + OQ + PQ；Group C（系統級儀器，如 HPLC）需完整電腦化系統驗證。
blocks.en: Group B instruments: USP <1058> classifies instruments by complexity. Group A (simple tools, such as volumetric flasks) needs no formal OQ; Group B (instruments with a measurement function, such as osmometers, balances and pH meters) needs IQ + OQ + PQ; Group C (system-level instruments, such as HPLC) needs full computerized system validation.

blocks.zh: 資格確認三層架構：
blocks.en: The three-tier qualification structure:

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝資格確認）：硬體與軟體已正確安裝在指定位置
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification): the hardware and software are correctly installed in the designated location

blocks.zh: OQ（操作資格確認）：儀器在規格範圍內正常運作（精確度 + 準確度）
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification): the instrument operates properly within its specification range (precision + accuracy)

blocks.zh: PQ（效能資格確認）：在常規使用條件下持續符合性能要求
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification): the instrument continues to meet performance requirements under routine conditions of use

blocks.zh: 儀器資格確認就像新車驗收：IQ = 確認車型、配備、VIN 號都符合訂單；OQ = 試車道測試剎車、轉向、儀表板都正常運作；PQ = 正式上路後定期保養記錄，確認長期可靠性。三個階段缺一不可，共同確保「這台車在我的道路條件下安全可靠」。
blocks.en: Instrument qualification is like accepting delivery of a new car: IQ = confirming that the model, equipment and VIN match the order; OQ = testing the brakes, steering and dashboard on a test track to confirm they work; PQ = the regular maintenance record once the car is on the road, confirming long-term reliability. None of the three stages can be omitted; together they ensure that "this car is safe and reliable under my road conditions".

blocks.zh: 「fit for the intended purpose」是 USP 的核心判斷標準。不是所有滲透量計都需要驗證到同一水準——關鍵是「在你的測量範圍和精度要求下」是否合格。一台用於測量 50–500 mOsmol/kg 的儀器，不需要驗證到 4000 mOsmol/kg。這給了 CDMO 根據產品需求制定合適資格確認方案的彈性。
blocks.en: "Fit for the intended purpose" is the core criterion of USP. Not every osmometer needs to be qualified to the same level; the key is whether it is suitable "for your measurement range and accuracy requirements". An instrument used to measure 50–500 mOsmol/kg does not need to be qualified up to 4000 mOsmol/kg. This gives a CDMO the flexibility to design a qualification program appropriate to its product needs.

blocks.zh: 為何 osmometer 被歸類為 Group B 而非 Group A 儀器？請從儀器功能的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is an osmometer classified as a Group B rather than a Group A instrument? Explain from the standpoint of instrument function.

blocks.zh: 若你的產品 osmolality 規格為 280–320 mOsmol/kg，資格確認應覆蓋哪個範圍？為什麼不需要涵蓋 50–4000 mOsmol/kg？
blocks.en: If your product osmolality specification is 280–320 mOsmol/kg, what range should the qualification cover? Why does it not need to cover 50–4000 mOsmol/kg?

blocks.zh: Installation Qualification (IQ) 安裝資格確認
blocks.en: Installation Qualification (IQ)

blocks.zh: IQ 典型查核項目
blocks.en: Typical IQ Checklist Items

blocks.zh: 儀器序號、型號與採購訂單/接收文件核對
blocks.en: Instrument serial number and model checked against the purchase order / receiving documents

blocks.zh: 安裝位置（溫度、濕度、振動、電源規格）符合廠商規格
blocks.en: Installation location (temperature, humidity, vibration, power supply specification) meets the manufacturer specification

blocks.zh: 軟體版本記錄（若有）
blocks.en: Software version record (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 附件清單（標準液、耗材）完整
blocks.en: Accessory list (standards, consumables) complete

blocks.zh: 廠商安裝證書（COI）存檔
blocks.en: Manufacturer installation certificate (COI) on file

blocks.zh: 蒸氣壓法滲透量計對環境溫度特別敏感，IQ 時必須確認安裝位置：避免冷氣出風口直吹、避免陽光直射、與暖氣設備保持距離。這些環境因素若在 IQ 未記錄，往往成為後期 OQ 不通過的根本原因。
blocks.en: The vapor pressure osmometer is particularly sensitive to ambient temperature, so the installation location must be confirmed at IQ: avoid direct airflow from air-conditioning vents, avoid direct sunlight, and keep away from heating equipment. If these environmental factors are not recorded at IQ, they often turn out to be the root cause of a later OQ failure.

blocks.zh: Operational Qualification (OQ) 操作資格確認
blocks.en: Operational Qualification (OQ)

blocks.zh: OQ 兩大驗證指標：
blocks.en: The two key OQ verification parameters:

blocks.zh: Precision（精確度）：多次重複測量同一標準液的一致性，以 RSD 表示。RSD ≤ 2% 是 USP 的最低標準。反映儀器的「穩定性」。
blocks.en: Precision: the consistency of repeated measurements of the same standard solution, expressed as RSD. RSD ≤ 2% is the USP minimum standard. It reflects the "stability" of the instrument.

blocks.zh: Accuracy（準確度）：測量值與標準值的接近程度。反映儀器的「正確性」。低濃度用絕對值（±4 mOsmol/kg），高濃度用相對值（±1%），因為高濃度的絕對誤差本身就更大。
blocks.en: Accuracy: how close the measured value is to the standard value. It reflects the "correctness" of the instrument. Absolute values are used at low concentrations (±4 mOsmol/kg) and relative values at high concentrations (±1%), because the absolute error at high concentration is inherently larger.

blocks.zh: OQ 計算示例
blocks.en: OQ Calculation Example

blocks.zh:
精確度計算 (Precision):
  測量 290 mOsmol/kg 標準液 n=6 次:
  結果: 288, 291, 290, 289, 292, 290
  平均值 X̄₀ = 290.0
  標準差 σ = 1.41 (用 n-1 自由度)
  R% = 100 × 1.41 / 290.0 = 0.49%
  → 通過 (≤ 2%)

  精確度換算到 400 mOsmol/kg 樣品:
  R_osm = 0.49% × 400 / 100 = 1.96 mOsmol/kg

準確度判定 (Accuracy):
  標準值 = 290 mOsmol/kg (≤400 mOsmol/kg)
  接受標準: ±4 mOsmol/kg
  → 儀器讀數必須在 286–294 mOsmol/kg

  標準值 = 1000 mOsmol/kg (>400 mOsmol/kg)
  接受標準: ±1% = ±10 mOsmol/kg
  → 儀器讀數必須在 990–1010 mOsmol/kg
blocks.en:
Precision calculation:
  Measure the 290 mOsmol/kg standard n=6 times:
  Results: 288, 291, 290, 289, 292, 290
  Mean X̄₀ = 290.0
  Standard deviation σ = 1.41 (using n-1 degrees of freedom)
  R% = 100 × 1.41 / 290.0 = 0.49%
  → Pass (≤ 2%)

  Converting precision to a 400 mOsmol/kg sample:
  R_osm = 0.49% × 400 / 100 = 1.96 mOsmol/kg

Accuracy determination:
  Standard value = 290 mOsmol/kg (≤400 mOsmol/kg)
  Acceptance criterion: ±4 mOsmol/kg
  → The instrument reading must be within 286–294 mOsmol/kg

  Standard value = 1000 mOsmol/kg (>400 mOsmol/kg)
  Acceptance criterion: ±1% = ±10 mOsmol/kg
  → The instrument reading must be within 990–1010 mOsmol/kg

blocks.zh: Buzz 參數優化的重要性：凍結點法中，buzz point 和 buzz amplitude 直接影響能否可靠凍結不同類型的樣品。高黏度樣品、含表面活性劑的樣品、含蛋白質的樣品都可能需要不同的 buzz 設定。OQ 階段必須用有代表性的矩陣（基質）測試，而非只用純水或 NaCl 溶液。
blocks.en: The importance of optimizing buzz parameters: in the freezing-point method, the buzz point and buzz amplitude directly affect whether different types of sample can be frozen reliably. High-viscosity samples, samples containing surfactants and samples containing protein may each need different buzz settings. At the OQ stage, testing must use a representative matrix, not just pure water or NaCl solution.

blocks.zh: 「n−1 自由度」：這是樣本標準差（非母體標準差）的計算方式，適用於有限樣本的不確定度評估，是統計學正確做法。
blocks.en: "n−1 degrees of freedom": this is the way to calculate the sample standard deviation (not the population standard deviation), which is appropriate for assessing the uncertainty of a finite sample and is the statistically correct practice.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的儀器資格確認實踐中，OQ 的精確度測試應選擇「接近日常使用範圍中心點」的標準液，而非任意濃度。若你的注射劑產品規格是 280–320 mOsmol/kg，則應選用 290 mOsmol/kg 標準液進行 OQ 精確度測試，以確保在最相關的測量範圍內已充分驗證。
blocks.en: In CDMO instrument qualification practice, the OQ precision test should use a standard "close to the center of the routine working range", not an arbitrary concentration. If your injectable product specification is 280–320 mOsmol/kg, the 290 mOsmol/kg standard should be used for the OQ precision test, so that the most relevant measurement range is fully verified.

blocks.zh: OQ 精確度測試需要至少幾次重複測量？為何使用 (n−1) 而非 (n) 作為標準差計算的自由度？
blocks.en: How many repeat measurements does the OQ precision test require at minimum? Why is (n−1) rather than (n) used as the degrees of freedom in the standard deviation calculation?

blocks.zh: 若一台滲透量計的準確度測試中，300 mOsmol/kg 標準液讀得 305 mOsmol/kg，是否通過 OQ 準確度標準？請計算說明。
blocks.en: In an osmometer accuracy test, the 300 mOsmol/kg standard reads 305 mOsmol/kg. Does it meet the OQ accuracy criterion? Show your calculation.

blocks.zh: 「Buzz 點」優化為什麼必須在 OQ 階段完成，而不是等到日常使用時再調整？
blocks.en: Why must "buzz point" optimization be completed at the OQ stage rather than adjusted later during routine use?

blocks.zh: Performance Qualification (PQ) 效能資格確認
blocks.en: Performance Qualification (PQ)

blocks.zh: PQ 的兩個核心機制：
blocks.en: The two core mechanisms of PQ:

blocks.zh: Periodic recalibration（定期重新校正）：依廠商建議或內部 SOP 設定頻率（通常每季或每半年），使用 Table 1 標準液完整校正，並用更高/更低標準液確認準確度
blocks.en: Periodic recalibration: the frequency is set according to the manufacturer recommendation or the internal SOP (usually quarterly or every six months); a full calibration is performed with the Table 1 standards, and accuracy is confirmed with higher/lower standards

blocks.zh: Day-of-use calibration check（每日使用前校正確認）：每次使用前執行簡短確認，確保儀器在當日狀態下仍符合準確度標準
blocks.en: Day-of-use calibration check: a short check performed before each use to ensure that the instrument still meets the accuracy criteria on the day

blocks.zh: 趨勢監測（Trending）是 PQ 的精髓。每日校正確認結果應記入趨勢圖，用統計製程管控（SPC）工具觀察是否有系統性漂移（drift）或突然偏移（shift）。這能在儀器性能惡化導致產品放行失敗前提前預警，是符合 ICH Q10 製藥品質體系持續改進精神的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: Trending is the essence of PQ. The results of the daily calibration check should be recorded on a trend chart, and statistical process control (SPC) tools used to look for systematic drift or sudden shifts. This gives early warning before deteriorating instrument performance causes a product release failure, and it is a best practice consistent with the continual improvement spirit of the ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system.

blocks.zh: PQ 就像汽車行駛里程追蹤：定期保養（periodic recalibration）確保大系統正常；每次出發前的快速檢查（day-of-use check）確保當天狀況良好；把每次油耗記錄下來看趨勢（trending），就能提前發現引擎問題，而不是在高速公路上拋錨才知道出事了。
blocks.en: PQ is like tracking a car's mileage: periodic maintenance (periodic recalibration) keeps the major systems in order; a quick check before every trip (day-of-use check) ensures the car is in good shape that day; and logging fuel consumption each time to look at the trend (trending) lets you spot engine problems early instead of finding out when you break down on the highway.

blocks.zh: Day-of-use calibration check 與 OQ 中的準確度測試有何相似之處？為什麼兩者接受標準相同（±4 mOsmol/kg 或 ±1%）？
blocks.en: How is the day-of-use calibration check similar to the accuracy test in OQ? Why are the acceptance criteria the same (±4 mOsmol/kg or ±1%)?

blocks.zh: 若趨勢圖顯示滲透量計的每日校正確認值在近一個月內持續偏高 3 mOsmol/kg，你作為 QC 負責人應採取哪些措施？
blocks.en: If the trend chart shows that the daily calibration check values of the osmometer have been consistently 3 mOsmol/kg too high over the past month, what actions should you take as QC head?

blocks.zh: PQ 的重新校正頻率由什麼因素決定？請列出至少三個考量點。
blocks.en: What factors determine the recalibration frequency in PQ? List at least three considerations.

blocks.zh: 儀器類型對比表 Instrument Comparison Summary
blocks.en: Instrument Comparison Summary

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 凍結點法（Method 1）利用相變平台讀取凍結點，靈敏度高（K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86），是注射劑 QC 的主流方法；蒸氣壓法（Method 2）在室溫操作，樣品量少，但不適用於揮發性樣品
blocks.en: The freezing-point method (Method 1) reads the freezing point from the phase-change plateau; it has high sensitivity (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86) and is the mainstream method for injectable QC. The vapor pressure method (Method 2) operates at room temperature and needs little sample, but is not suitable for volatile samples

blocks.zh: 同一樣品兩種方法結果可能不同，根本原因是測量溫度不同導致溶質活性係數改變——這是物理現象，非誤差
blocks.en: The two methods may give different results for the same sample because the different measurement temperatures change the solute activity coefficients; this is a physical phenomenon, not an error

blocks.zh: Osmometer 屬 Group B 儀器（USP 〈1058〉），需完整 IQ → OQ → PQ 資格確認鏈
blocks.en: The osmometer is a Group B instrument (USP <1058>) and requires the full IQ → OQ → PQ qualification chain

blocks.zh: OQ 精確度標準：RSD ≤ 2%（≥6 次重複）；準確度：±4 mOsmol/kg（≤400）或 ±1%（>400）
blocks.en: OQ precision criterion: RSD ≤ 2% (≥6 replicates); accuracy: ±4 mOsmol/kg (≤400) or ±1% (>400)

blocks.zh: PQ = 定期重新校正 + 每日使用前確認 + 長期趨勢監測；趨勢監測是早期發現儀器性能衰退的關鍵工具
blocks.en: PQ = periodic recalibration + day-of-use check + long-term trend monitoring; trend monitoring is the key tool for detecting instrument performance deterioration early
